title: --remove takes out the block lines and the break jitso added, and keeps text written after the block
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D8 (setup instructions, defect N-18): a delimited, reversible JITSO block in the instruction files agents read
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-18, setup instructions). The file holds the original, the block (`added=1`) and a paragraph the user wrote afterwards. `--remove --yes` deletes the lines from BEGIN to END with their break, then one break before them (`added=1`), and leaves the rest as it is.
